trackerLog.subject: Asteria

feature.title: World Cannon as industrial superweapon
feature.notes: Physical barrel aims vertical, spaceward. Who it is really built to hit is still open. Vortan's public target remains Temple of Fire, not the Invasion. The machine sits on older unlit ruins: smooth pale stone, FF16 Fallen color and form, no interior lighting in the ancient blocks. Constium industry is bolted on later. Firing still unseals Nyxara. Not adjacent to the Temple of Fire plate.

Bengenia. Aspect: standing mist, form, visibility. Cannot be cleared. Layout sheet is now the consistency spec for colonnade, standing-mist court, naming hall, Veil Sigil chamber. Keep the accepted mood plate; block rooms from the layout.

Constium highlands. Aspect: stone, rail, seismic hold. Entrance plate stands. Exterior consistency elevation plus interior layout and Keystone hall plate added. If Earth fails, Constium works slump and the Cannon listing changes. Sigil: Keystone.

East cape above Queen's Cove. Aspect: tide, river, King's Sea. Caustic light on the first plate is not a shippable material. Layout sheet plus overcast readable complex plate are the consistency spec. Sigil: Undertow.
North volcanic highland, not next to the World Cannon. Aspect: heat, forge, Nyxara leak. Redo plate removes the barrel from the sky. Corruption here is Nyxara speaking through prayer. Sigil: Cinder.

Temple of Life sits at the end of a long peninsula, same massing idea as Temple of Light, with substantially more greenery and trees. South of King's Sea above Tierso. Aspect: crops, birth, field healing, blight. Sigil: Root.

trackerLog.decision: World Cannon barrel is vertical / spaceward. Ruins under it are unlit smooth Fallen-style stone. Industry is later.
Temple of Fire is not adjacent to the World Cannon. Temple of Life is a green peninsula shrine in the Light massing family.
